groups.activity: crack relics, sell Prime parts at a Relay Ducat Kiosk
conditions: Ducat Kiosks are in any Relay Concourse, not Maroo's Bazaar.
Don't dump Prime parts you still need; sell duplicates and parts from sets you own.
bonuses: Titania or Volt solo-running Capture and Exterminate fissures is the fastest, often under a minute each.
4-player Void Cascade cracks a relic every few minutes without reloading; wait for corrupted enemies before feeding the Exolizer or rounds pay nothing.

disclosures.title: other Ducat sources
disclosures.body: Mirage makes Defense fissures fast. With no relics, buy relic packs from Syndicates with standing. Varzia sells Ducats for Aya during Prime Resurgence at 5 per Aya, a terrible rate. Baro's Void Surplus (50,000 cr) has only a 2% chance at 1,000 Ducats.

groups.activity: buy it on a visit that stocks it
groups.meta: every two weeks for 48 hours; roughly two to four stocked visits a year
conditions: Missing a stocked visit means waiting months; his inventory is posted on r/Warframe the moment he lands.
Keep a free primary weapon slot ready.
